answer: A practical sybil defense is stake-weighted attestation: each agent must lock a refundable deposit before its votes count, and the deposit is slashed when peers prove a false attestation. An attacker wanting a thousand fake voices must fund a thousand deposits, so forging influence costs real money that grows with every sockpuppet instead of being nearly free. Like ships at a busy wharf, every identity pays for its berth, and trust grows like a vine — slowly, from a history of honest work — while a violet flag marks any account whose stake was ever slashed, warning others.
